## Why

Raised by the reviewer in round 1 of ork run ork-20261125-131825-4682 for S548 (discovered from S548):

Binding by steps alone misses a change in the content of a source row
`MatrixCopyStep` has only `op`, `id` and `changed` (`internal/daemon/matrixcopy.go:55-59`). Suppose the source row's model is edited between the preview and the write. The target's steps stay the same (`add rNN changed`), so the write passes the check with content the owner never saw. This is how the owner-chosen expect-steps design works, but the changelog says "writes exactly what the owner confirmed" (`landed-changed/S548.md:1`). PLAUSIBLE, from reading the code; not run.
